support_faq_a3: Absolutely. We take your privacy seriously. We only store your email and hashed password for login purposes. We never share your data with third parties.

landing_ask_intro: Ask me what this platform stores, how it helps with exams, or how the roadmap turns into action.
landing_ask_quick_2: Can it help with mock tests?
landing_ask_answer_roadmap: Roadmaps use your profile, skills, exams, and career goals to create stages. Each stage can become a saved AI guide with actions, resources, and a completion checklist.
landing_ask_answer_practice: The AI Tutor generates practice questions and mock tests. Wrong answers become revision material so you can return to the exact mistakes later.
landing_ask_answer_scholarship: Scholarship search can use profile context, then saved opportunities become an application tracker with status and deadlines.
landing_ask_answer_guest: Guest mode opens a preview workspace. You can explore key flows, but saved roadmaps, mock history, profile memory, and library data need an account.
landing_ask_answer_default: Potho Prodorshok is a logged-in career workspace: plan your path, practice for exams, save useful outputs, and return to your progress from one dashboard.
